notes.title: Public test is now the official version!
notes.notes:
We're launching the public updated changes to the default game, which includes the new rendering and other changes!

Since this can present some incompatibilities, if you're experiencing troubles running the new patch, you can go to the game properties on steam, and select the "oldver" to use the previous version for now.

We're still working on the next patch, which should include more art and engine changes, and quality of life improvements, and fixing some bugs found in the last public test. Long term, we're working on significant gameplay changes! We're also taking into account your suggestions for other priority features to work on.

Thanks for riding!

notes.title: Tiny update: Streamliner Trainset test
notes.notes:
Have you been playing our public test over the holidays? We snuck in a test version of an upcoming streamliner trainset on Christmas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30772860/cae6b5813f4a33517b060c0f4d04ab6792e9b778.jpg[/img]

More feature updates and content coming in the new year!

How to Play:
Opt-in to our public test version!
[list]
[*]     Right click on TFC in your library (or select the Settings cog on the game page)
[*]     Select [i]Properties [/i]in the drop down menu
[*]     Under the properties tab, select [i]Betas[/i]
[*]     Change[i] Beta Participation[/i] drop down from [i]None [/i]to [i]publictest[/i]
[/list]

How to make sure your new version is ready and updated:
[list]
[*]     Go to properties tab [i]Installed Files[/i]
[*]     Then use the [i]'Verify integrity of game files' [/i]feature
[*]     In library the game should be named [i]Train Frontier Classic [publictest][/i]
[/list]

[i]Map: 'Leandro Rails Co' by Lensilver[/i]
